The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ire Eleazari]] controlled an '''asteroid''' in the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A lopsided asteroid barely half a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] long, Eleazari's installation was at the bottom of a deep crater with the surface appearing to maintain no life.
